relationships.subject: Spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed significantly stronger mechanical allodynia in females and numerous sexually dimorphic changes in gene expression following SNI in rats.

relationships.subject: Spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunostaining for CGRP (Calcitonin gene-related peptide) in L4 DRG in males demonstrated 42% fewer (p < 0.05) CGRP-positive cells on the ipsilateral side than on the contralateral side, following SNI

relationships.subject: Spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI rats showed a significantly larger area of IBA1 staining on the ipsilateral side of L4 SC tissue in ventral horns (VHs) and dorsal horns (DHs)

relationships.subject: Spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The greatest upregulation occurred in Cxcl13, Loc299282 and downregulation in Hoxd9 and Rpe65.

key_findings: Female rats show stronger mechanical allodynia after SNI; DRG and spinal cord show sexually dimorphic gene expression (T-cell, immune, plasticity genes).
SNI reduces CGRP+ and IB4+ cells in L4 DRG similarly in both sexes.
